Subject: Draft: Aug 26 'Serving LLMs at Scale' webinar - invite & co-promo

Hi team / Emily,

Attached is the first full draft of the invite and the co-promotion assets for the Aug 26 webinar ("Serving LLMs at Scale"). High level asks:

- Quick copy pass (subject + first 2 lines) for mobile clarity.
- Segmentation: confirm which lists we push (see "segmentation notes" below).
- Tracking: confirm UTM params and HubSpot campaign link below.
- Reminders cadence: agree on RSVP reminder timings and who sends the calendar invite.

Attachments: invite_assets_v3.zip (HTML + plain text), redwood_webinar_landing_page.png, cleveranalytics_logo.svg

Draft invite copy (HTML/plain text combined):
Subject: Serving LLMs at Scale — Lessons from production (Aug 26)
Preheader: How to balance latency, cost, and reliability for LLM-powered features

Hi {{first_name}},

Join Redwood Inference and Clever Analytics for a 45-minute session on practical strategies for running LLMs in production. We'll cover runtime optimizations, routing policies, and real-world cost-control patterns.

What you'll get:
- Engineering patterns for sub-100ms token latency
- Cost-saving batching and caching tactics
- A short live demo and 15 minutes for Q&A

Register here: https://redwood.com/webinars/serving-llms-at-scale?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=webinar_aug26 (HubSpot registration form will be attached to the campaign)

Co-promote note: Emily, can you confirm the short blurb (one-line partner intro) you want in the co-branded header?

Segmentation notes (proposed):
- Primary list: product/platform engineers who have used hosted APIs in last 12 months (~18k).
- Secondary: enterprise prospects in HubSpot lifecycle stage Opportunity or SQL (~420 accounts).
- Partner-only: Clever Analytics customers (Emily will provide list).

Initial RSVP reminder cadence (propose):
- T-7 days: reminder to registrants (email)
- T-1 day: calendar invite + reminder
- Day-of: 90-min reminder to registrants who haven't joined (email + SMS if opt-in)

Please reply with quick edits — ideally before EOD so we can freeze assets for the designer tomorrow.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

--

- Secondary accounts: shared list in HubSpot: "Enterprise_Webinar_Aug26" (ID: 3421). I'll add an "owner" column so AEs get a heads-up when an account registers.
- Partner list: Emily — please send us a CSV of partner-only emails by 8/3 so we can load and suppress overlaps.

Reminders cadence tweaks:
- T-7 day: marketing sends a soft reminder to registrants.
- T-3 day: partner sends their own reminder to partner list (co-brand).
- T-1 day: send calendar + 30 second teaser video in email.
- Day-of: 60-min reminder instead; we'll do 90 if last-minute registrants spike.

Tracking: use UTM source=email, utm_medium=webinar_invite, utm_campaign=webinar_aug26, utm_content={variant}. HubSpot campaign will be WEB-2026-08-26.
